about: Library of Congress (loc.gov): read the homepage's featured stories, trending content, top searches and gallery highlights, and fetch WebVTT captions for LOC webcast videos.

commands.summary: List the featured stories in the rotating banner on the Library of Congress homepage (title, description, link).
List trending items on the homepage (blog posts, magazine articles, videos), with their format (Blog, Magazine, Watch) and link.
List the 'Top Searches' terms shown on the homepage, with their loc.gov search URLs.
List the captioned collection photos in the homepage masonry gallery.
Fetch the WebVTT caption/transcript track for a Library of Congress webcast video served from tile.loc.gov.

params.name: media_id
params.description: IIIF media identifier of the webcast rendition. Colon-separated, e.g. media:webcasts:<year>:<id>:<id>-<WxH>_<bitrate>. It appears in the video URLs on loc.gov pages.

params.name: track
params.description: Caption track index (0 = first or default track).
